description: Tier-2 detail for ONE page of an already-mapped datasheet: the full measured anatomy (text metrics, MuPDF geometry census, structural geometry signals), the page's own headings and first lines, and which modules claim the page. Use it AFTER datasheetvend_extract_document_map, when the Tier-1 index says a page matters and its one-line summary is not enough. Pass the document.sha256 from the map (served free from cache). Set include_physical=true ONLY when you truly need the raw positioned tokens/vector paths — that payload can weigh hundreds of KB for one dense page. Read-only; never rebuilds, never bills.

documentRef.description: The document.sha256 from a prior datasheetvend_extract_document_map result (preferred), or the same document path/URL.

include_physical.description: Include the raw MuPDF physical reconstruction (positioned tokens, vector paths). Heavy — default false.

page.description: Physical 1-based PDF page number to inspect.

name: datasheetvend_inspect_document_page

cached.description: Whether served from the Document Map cache

inspection.description: status ok: document_map_page_inspection_v1 (page, form, headings, claimed_by_modules, anatomy, physical_map)

page.description: status page_out_of_range: the page that was asked for

status.description: ok, or page_out_of_range when the map has no such page

total_pages.description: status page_out_of_range: the map's page count

title: Inspect one mapped page (Tier-2 detail)
